url.description: The remote URL to mount as a virtual filesystem.

mountpoint.description: The local directory where the virtual filesystem will be mounted.

username.description: HTTP authentication username for the source server.

password.description: HTTP authentication password for the source server.

proxy_cacert.description: Certificate authority file for verifying the proxy's SSL certificate.

cache_location.description: Custom location for the cache directory.

cacert.description: Certificate authority file for verifying the source server's SSL certificate.

dl_seg_size.description: Cache download segment size in MB.

http_headers.description: HTTP headers to include in requests. Items are strings formatted as 'Key: Value'. See items schema for details.

http_headers.items.description: A single HTTP header formatted as 'Key: Value'.

max_seg_count.description: Maximum number of download segments a file can have.

max_conns.description: Maximum number of network connections libcurl can make.

refresh_timeout.description: Time in seconds before directories are refreshed.

retry_wait.description: Delay in seconds before retrying an HTTP request after error.

user_agent.description: User agent string to send with requests.

no_range_check.description: Disable the built-in check for server support of HTTP range requests.

single_file_mode.description: Single file mode: present a single file instead of a whole directory.

single_file_path.description: The specific file path within the remote directory to expose in single-file mode.

sonic_id3.description: Enable ID3 mode for Artist/Album/Song layout.

sonic_insecure.description: Use insecure authentication scheme for Airsonic/Subsonic.
